The '''Kandarin Diary''' is an [[Achievement Diary]] whose tasks revolve around areas in and near the northern part of [[Kandarin]], such as [[Seers' Village]], [[Catherby]], and the [[Barbarian Outpost]].

Several skill, quest, and item requirements are needed to complete all tasks. Unless stated otherwise, [[temporary skill boost]]s can be used to meet the skill requirements.

Rewards can be claimed from [[The 'Wedge']] outside the entrance to [[Camelot]]. Tasks may be done in any order, but the previous tiers of a diary must be completed to claim rewards of the next tier.
